title: Replacing a 90-Second Framework Build with 0.01s Kaze Engine
objective: Eliminate CI build bottlenecks, security patch cycles, and dependency deprecations across client editorial properties.
results: Reduced cold CI build time from 84 seconds down to 0.01 seconds.
Eliminated 1,200+ npm packages and 450MB node_modules footprint entirely.
Achieved perfect 100/100 Lighthouse performance and accessibility scores on edge.
Decoupled editorial workflow allowing writers to edit in browser with zero server costs.
